**[posthog/api/organization_invite.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/api/organization_invite.py)** * **Moved membership validation into field validation:** Added organization membership check (`OrganizationMembership.objects.filter(...)`) to [`OrganizationInviteSerializer.validate_target_email()`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/api/organization_invite.py#L197-L217) with error code `user_already_member`. * **Prevented partial bulk invite creation:** Because DRF validates all items via `serializer.is_valid()` before `serializer.save()` is executed, if any email in a bulk batch belongs to an existing member or the user themselves, `serializer.is_valid()` returns `False` immediately. `first_bulk_invite_error` raises the validation error up front, completely preventing any invites from being created or emails being sent for earlier rows in the batch. * **Added atomic transaction safety:** Wrapped `serializer.save()` in `with transaction.atomic():` in the `bulk` action. * **Updated error code:** Added `code="user_already_member"` in `create()` as well. *
